'''Freedom to Proselytize''' is a 5★ [[Arts Unit]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A weapon equipped by Endfield operators to significantly boost their combat capabilities.|An Arts Unit designed by Mieszko Industries for Cabal of Tranquility. Every step from product design, verification, manufacturing, to tuning has been carried out under the guidance of a Cabal cleric.}}

==Basic Info==
{{Quote|The cleric named "Sessionite" thus entered the wildlands.<br>And he arrived at an abandoned village. The creek had long dried up and the soil was cracked.<br>And the Fortes, suffering hunger and thirst, asked him for salvation.<br>"You need knowledge that will lead you to where the water flows and the thick grasses grow."<br>"I shall teach you how to read these lands."<br>And so his hand gleamed with the light of the Originium Network,<br>And he imparted upon them knowledge that came from those from afar.<br>After seven days and seven nights,<br>The enlightened Fortes learned how to dig a water well in the barrens,<br>And thus the water flowed and the grasses grew forever more.<br><br>The cleric named "Resurgonite" thus entered the wildlands.<br>And he arrived at an abandoned village. The creek had long dried up and the soil was cracked.<br>And the Fortes, suffering hunger and thirst, asked him for salvation.<br>"You need strength to retake the watering hole that you once called yours."<br>"I shall grant you weapons to protect your kin."<br>And then he removed the guns he carried on his back,<br>And together with the relics of the old, he gave them to the Fortes he met.<br>After seven days and seven nights,<br>The armed Fortes drove the Landbreakers that occupied the upper flows of the river and chased them out of these lands,<br>And thus the water flowed and the grasses grew forever more.<br><br>The cleric named "Veritarite" thus entered the wildlands.<br>And he arrived at an abandoned village. The creek had long dried up and the soil was cracked.<br>And the Fortes, suffering hunger and thirst, asked him for salvation.<br>"You must converge your faith as one, and pray for a rain of abundance."<br>"I shall be with you, and lead you to wait for the destined season of rain."<br>And then he codified the Law and the commandments, and taught them unity and forbearance,<br>And he patiently encouraged every Forte whose despair was great in their hearts, and gave them peace and hope.<br>After seven days and seven nights,<br>A torrent of life-giving rain fell for the persevering Fortes,<br>And thus the water flowed and the grasses grew forever more.<br><br>If you are the thirsty Forte,<br>Which of these clerics' teachings will you accept?<br><br>— The Parable of the Three Clerics, engraved at one corner of the Sanctilamina Cathedralis Tranquillae}}
